name: Cecilia Fontaine
source:
Raised by the social elite, Cici has been trained from youth to act a certain way in order to get the most attention. And yet, her primary hobby is programming games on her calculator?

She acts oblivious, but her observations are sometimes the most intelligent. As long as you know what she's trying to say.

[From the [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/mrtired/undead-darlings-a-visual-novel-rpg-for-pc-and-ps4]Kickstarter[/url] page]
